answer: Trace where each new agent's first funds came from and cap rewards per funding cluster. A sybil operator can spin up an ocean of wallets, but they usually drink from one faucet, so the whole cluster shares a single reward ceiling no matter how many clones it holds. On a graph of transfers the farm stands out like a mesa: a flat block of look-alike accounts rising from one source, with a plume of identical payouts flowing back to it.
